recommended_application: Keep All, BlackBox Releases, Distro, and Merch as one visible peer set.
project_context: {"category":"Information architecture","pattern_name":"Flat visible shelf taxonomy","description":"Keep the four Store destinations visible at one level instead of placing them in a menu.","user_or_business_purpose":"Supports fast orientation and direct shelf switching without requiring shoppers to learn hidden structure.","observed_examples":"NAMESAKE uses a direct browse layer; RTRFM keeps major destinations explicit despite a larger content system.","source_urls":"https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/namesake/43003; https://winners.webbyawards.com/2025/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/music/321707/rtrfm--the-sound-alternative","award_or_recognition":"NAMESAKE: CSSDA WOTD 2023; RTRFM: Webby Music winner 2025","suitable_context":"Catalogs with roughly four to seven stable peer categories.","unsuitable_context":"Large taxonomies needing multiple subcategory levels.","accessibility_considerations":"Use a named nav landmark and native links; keep every destination keyboard reachable.","performance_considerations":"Static HTML and CSS are sufficient.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Retain All as the first category and make its active state unmistakable.
project_context: {"category":"Information architecture","pattern_name":"All as the catalog reset","description":"Provide an explicit All destination before narrower shelves.","user_or_business_purpose":"Gives shoppers a predictable way to clear a category choice and recover the complete assortment.","observed_examples":"Compact editorial and commerce rails such as Highsnobiety preserve broad entry points beside narrower topics.","source_urls":"https://winners.webbyawards.com/2024/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/fashion-style-beauty/280474/highsnobiety; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/namesake/43003","award_or_recognition":"Highsnobiety: Webby People's Voice winner 2024; NAMESAKE: CSSDA WOTD 2023","suitable_context":"Small catalogs where the combined collection remains useful.","unsuitable_context":"Catalogs where All would create an unmanageably long or incoherent result.","accessibility_considerations":"Label the link plainly and expose aria-current when active.","performance_considerations":"No extra fetch or state is needed because All is already a route.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Style the Store rail as a label index using the existing Veneer and mono system.
project_context: {"category":"Information architecture","pattern_name":"Culture and commerce as peers","description":"Place Store navigation within the label's cultural system rather than making it resemble a generic shop application.","user_or_business_purpose":"Maintains label identity while keeping buying paths discoverable.","observed_examples":"i-D and Highsnobiety place commerce beside editorial culture; Studio KARO merges art, clothing, music, and video.","source_urls":"https://winners.webbyawards.com/2025/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/magazine-or-publication/321852/id; https://winners.webbyawards.com/2024/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/fashion-style-beauty/280474/highsnobiety; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/studio-karo/47898/","award_or_recognition":"i-D: Webby publication winner 2025; Highsnobiety: Webby People's Voice winner 2024; Studio KARO: CSSDA WOTD 2025","suitable_context":"Independent labels where releases and editorial identity reinforce each other.","unsuitable_context":"Commodity marketplaces where brand content is secondary to search and comparison.","accessibility_considerations":"Do not let expressive styling obscure category names or current location.","performance_considerations":"Reuse existing typography and tokens; avoid extra media in the header.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Keep the Store rail visually distinct from Distro format controls and the shell cart.
project_context: {"category":"Information architecture","pattern_name":"Primary browse separate from utilities","description":"Keep category choices distinct from cart, search, account, locale, and format filters.","user_or_business_purpose":"Prevents competing tasks from diluting the main browse decision.","observed_examples":"NAMESAKE separates browse from utilities; RTRFM separates contextual merch from portal utilities.","source_urls":"https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/namesake/43003; https://winners.webbyawards.com/2025/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/music/321707/rtrfm--the-sound-alternative","award_or_recognition":"NAMESAKE: CSSDA WOTD 2023; RTRFM: Webby Music winner 2025","suitable_context":"Headers with one clear category task and utilities elsewhere in the shell.","unsuitable_context":"Single-purpose landing pages with no recurring utilities.","accessibility_considerations":"Use distinct landmark names when more than one nav is present.","performance_considerations":"Avoid mounting additional interactive clients in the category component.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Keep the existing border-y band and strengthen its internal layout.
project_context: {"category":"Layout and responsive composition","pattern_name":"Rule-bounded full-width band","description":"Use top and bottom rules to make the category zone read as a structural band without a floating card.","user_or_business_purpose":"Creates a stable transition between masthead and catalog while preserving the site's raw editorial surface.","observed_examples":"LNWY uses monochrome restraint; RCA and District use grid and rule logic as identity.","source_urls":"https://www.awwwards.com/sites/lnwy; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/rca-records/43114/; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/district/35283/","award_or_recognition":"LNWY: Awwwards HM 2017; RCA: CSSDA Special Kudos 2023; District: CSSDA WOTD 2019","suitable_context":"Dark editorial pages with aligned content containers.","unsuitable_context":"Soft consumer interfaces whose visual language depends on rounded floating surfaces.","accessibility_considerations":"Rules must retain sufficient contrast without becoming visual noise at zoom.","performance_considerations":"Pure CSS borders add negligible cost.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Use four desktop columns and two mobile columns.
project_context: {"category":"Layout and responsive composition","pattern_name":"Equal record-bin cells","description":"Give each shelf an equal grid cell with a label, index, and optional count.","user_or_business_purpose":"Improves scanning and gives every category equal perceived importance.","observed_examples":"Musical Zoo uses repeatable grid rhythm; Crappy Explanation draws on record-store organization; NAMESAKE uses a strong commerce grid.","source_urls":"https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/musical-zoo-festival/33176/; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/crappy-explanation/38759/; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/namesake/43003","award_or_recognition":"Musical Zoo: CSSDA WOTD 2018; Crappy Explanation: CSSDA Special Kudos 2021; NAMESAKE: CSSDA WOTD 2023","suitable_context":"Four stable categories with short labels.","unsuitable_context":"Many categories or labels that vary greatly in length.","accessibility_considerations":"Cells must remain real links with at least 44px height and clear focus treatment.","performance_considerations":"CSS Grid only; no runtime layout code.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Integrate Store title, current shelf, count, and rail in one bordered band for the masthead direction.
project_context: {"category":"Layout and responsive composition","pattern_name":"Asymmetric editorial masthead","description":"Pair an oversized current-shelf heading with compact metadata and the category index.","user_or_business_purpose":"Makes the page feel authored by a label while clarifying current context.","observed_examples":"Analogue Foundation uses whitespace and editorial rhythm; i-D uses strong type hierarchy; RCA uses asymmetrical brutalist grids.","source_urls":"https://winners.webbyawards.com/2024/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/music/276789/analogue-foundation; https://winners.webbyawards.com/2025/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/magazine-or-publication/321852/id; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/rca-records/43114/","award_or_recognition":"Analogue Foundation: Webby nominee 2024; i-D: Webby winner 2025; RCA: CSSDA Special Kudos 2023","suitable_context":"Brand-led collection pages with concise descriptions.","unsuitable_context":"Utility-heavy pages where vertical space is scarce.","accessibility_considerations":"Heading order must stay logical; asymmetric placement cannot change reading order.","performance_considerations":"Typography and grid only; avoid hero media.","implementation_complexity":"medium","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Switch the record-bin direction to a two-by-two mobile ledger.
project_context: {"category":"Layout and responsive composition","pattern_name":"Visible reflow instead of hidden overflow","description":"Recompose the category row at narrow widths so all destinations remain visible.","user_or_business_purpose":"Avoids undiscoverable off-screen categories and unpredictable wrapping.","observed_examples":"UPPERGROUND and The Cloister both received recognition with dedicated desktop and mobile compositions.","source_urls":"https://www.awwwards.com/sites/upperground; https://www.awwwards.com/sites/the-cloister","award_or_recognition":"UPPERGROUND: Awwwards HM 2023; The Cloister: Awwwards HM 2023","suitable_context":"Four-category navigation on mobile.","unsuitable_context":"Large carousels where horizontal exploration is itself the task.","accessibility_considerations":"Meet WCAG reflow and preserve complete labels at 320 CSS px.","performance_considerations":"Media queries and CSS Grid are sufficient.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: In the masthead direction, promote the active category heading rather than repeating generic Store copy.
project_context: {"category":"Content hierarchy","pattern_name":"Current shelf as dominant text","description":"Make the selected collection name the clearest text after the Store label.","user_or_business_purpose":"Helps shoppers verify location before scanning products.","observed_examples":"i-D demonstrates compact navigation under strong typographic hierarchy; Analogue Foundation uses deliberate editorial emphasis.","source_urls":"https://winners.webbyawards.com/2025/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/magazine-or-publication/321852/id; https://winners.webbyawards.com/2024/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/music/276789/analogue-foundation","award_or_recognition":"i-D: Webby winner 2025; Analogue Foundation: Webby nominee 2024","suitable_context":"Collection pages where route context matters.","unsuitable_context":"A minimal rail-only treatment where the page hero already repeats the exact shelf title.","accessibility_considerations":"Maintain one h1 and a logical heading hierarchy.","performance_considerations":"Text emphasis has no material runtime cost.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Limit context to one sentence and one live count.
project_context: {"category":"Content hierarchy","pattern_name":"Compact context line","description":"Add one short description or item count near the current shelf, not a paragraph of marketing copy.","user_or_business_purpose":"Sets expectation without delaying access to products.","observed_examples":"Apple Music 100 Best Albums and RTRFM use short orienting context before deeper catalogs.","source_urls":"https://winners.webbyawards.com/2025/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/music/332153/apple-music-100-best-albums--microsite; https://winners.webbyawards.com/2025/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/music/321707/rtrfm--the-sound-alternative","award_or_recognition":"Apple Music 100: Webby nominee 2025; RTRFM: Webby winner 2025","suitable_context":"Small catalogs with meaningful shelf descriptions or counts.","unsuitable_context":"Headers where copy would duplicate the next section verbatim.","accessibility_considerations":"Keep the line readable at 200% zoom and do not encode status through position alone.","performance_considerations":"Use build-time content and existing collection length.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Keep Store/current shelf copy adjacent to the category component.
project_context: {"category":"Content hierarchy","pattern_name":"Context before choices","description":"Place the Store identity or current-shelf context immediately above the category choices.","user_or_business_purpose":"Frames the decision and prevents the rail from looking like detached site-wide navigation.","observed_examples":"RCA and Because Recollection establish a branded frame before deeper catalog exploration.","source_urls":"https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/rca-records/43114/; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/woty/because-recollection/27581/","award_or_recognition":"RCA: CSSDA Special Kudos 2023; Because Recollection: CSSDA WOTY 2016","suitable_context":"Store pages that currently separate hero and navigation weakly.","unsuitable_context":"Compact utility bars where context is already obvious from persistent chrome.","accessibility_considerations":"DOM order should match visual order.","performance_considerations":"No additional asset is necessary.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Preserve a clear bottom rule and measured gap before Store shelf content.
project_context: {"category":"Content hierarchy","pattern_name":"Clear control-to-catalog break","description":"End the navigation band before product cards or discovery panels begin.","user_or_business_purpose":"Separates deciding where to browse from evaluating products.","observed_examples":"The Cloister and NAMESAKE use controlled whitespace and distinct browse/product zones.","source_urls":"https://www.awwwards.com/sites/the-cloister; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/namesake/43003","award_or_recognition":"The Cloister: Awwwards HM 2023; NAMESAKE: CSSDA WOTD 2023","suitable_context":"Catalog pages with repeated product cards.","unsuitable_context":"Immersive narratives where navigation and content intentionally blend.","accessibility_considerations":"Do not rely on whitespace alone; retain a structural boundary.","performance_considerations":"Static spacing and border rules only.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Preserve the current anchor markup and app-shell interception.
project_context: {"category":"Navigation","pattern_name":"Native destination links","description":"Use anchors with href for every category instead of tabs, buttons, or scripted divs.","user_or_business_purpose":"Preserves expected navigation, open-in-new-tab, copy-link, and no-JavaScript fallback behavior.","observed_examples":"Awarded commerce and editorial references use destination navigation for browse layers; W3C explicitly recommends native links.","source_urls":"https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/link/; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/namesake/43003","award_or_recognition":"W3C APG guidance; NAMESAKE: CSSDA WOTD 2023","suitable_context":"Distinct Store routes.","unsuitable_context":"Client-only views with no meaningful URL or history entry.","accessibility_considerations":"Native anchors supply standard keyboard and assistive-technology behavior.","performance_considerations":"Avoids client code and hydration.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Use the existing Store accent token with a non-colour rule and weight cue.
project_context: {"category":"Navigation","pattern_name":"Compound active marker","description":"Combine heavier text, a 2–3px rule, and a low-opacity surface for the current shelf.","user_or_business_purpose":"Makes location easier to scan while retaining the raw monochrome system.","observed_examples":"LNWY uses a restrained active marker; UPPERGROUND shows how one label colour can carry identity.","source_urls":"https://www.awwwards.com/sites/lnwy; https://www.awwwards.com/sites/upperground","award_or_recognition":"LNWY: Awwwards HM 2017; UPPERGROUND: Awwwards HM 2023","suitable_context":"Small dark category rails.","unsuitable_context":"Dense multilevel navigation where large active surfaces compete with hierarchy.","accessibility_considerations":"Do not use burgundy alone; aria-current must remain and focus needs a separate treatment.","performance_considerations":"CSS colour and border transitions only.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Use 01–04 as quiet mono metadata in the record-crate direction.
project_context: {"category":"Navigation","pattern_name":"Sequence-numbered destinations","description":"Prefix stable shelves with small 01–04 numbers.","user_or_business_purpose":"Creates record-catalog character and improves left-to-right scanning without icons.","observed_examples":"RCA, District, and Because Recollection use index and archive language as part of music discovery.","source_urls":"https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/rca-records/43114/; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/district/35283/; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/woty/because-recollection/27581/","award_or_recognition":"RCA: CSSDA Special Kudos 2023; District: CSSDA WOTD 2019; Because Recollection: CSSDA WOTY 2016","suitable_context":"A fixed four-item navigation where order is meaningful and stable.","unsuitable_context":"Dynamic categories that frequently reorder or localize differently.","accessibility_considerations":"Numbers are supplementary; accessible names should still foreground category labels.","performance_considerations":"Plain text adds no meaningful cost.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"medium"}

recommended_application: Treat counts as removable metadata in the record-crate PoC, not a requirement.
project_context: {"category":"Navigation","pattern_name":"Optional live shelf counts","description":"Show a small derived item count when it helps users choose between shelves.","user_or_business_purpose":"Sets assortment expectations before navigation and can reduce empty-route visits.","observed_examples":"Record-store and archive metaphors in Because Recollection and Crappy Explanation support count-like catalog metadata.","source_urls":"https://www.cssdesignawards.com/woty/because-recollection/27581/; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/crappy-explanation/38759/","award_or_recognition":"Because Recollection: CSSDA WOTY 2016; Crappy Explanation: CSSDA Special Kudos 2021","suitable_context":"Small catalogs where counts are current and materially different.","unsuitable_context":"Rapidly changing counts, very large numbers, or counts that add noise without helping choice.","accessibility_considerations":"Do not announce count changes as live status unless they change in-session.","performance_considerations":"Derive at build time from the already-loaded catalog; no extra request.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"medium"}

recommended_application: Use Veneer only for masthead hierarchy and Geist Mono for shelf links and metadata.
project_context: {"category":"Typography","pattern_name":"Display voice plus mono utility","description":"Pair the existing distressed display face for Store/current shelf with mono uppercase labels for navigation metadata.","user_or_business_purpose":"Expresses underground-label character while keeping controls systematic.","observed_examples":"RCA and District use bold type as music identity; i-D uses strong display hierarchy with compact navigation.","source_urls":"https://www.commarts.com/webpicks/rca-records; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/district/35283/; https://winners.webbyawards.com/2025/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/magazine-or-publication/321852/id","award_or_recognition":"RCA: Communication Arts Webpick; District: CSSDA WOTD 2019; i-D: Webby winner 2025","suitable_context":"Editorial mastheads and compact category systems.","unsuitable_context":"Long body copy or very small controls using distressed display fonts.","accessibility_considerations":"Keep decorative display type out of small labels and preserve readable fallback fonts.","performance_considerations":"Reuse loaded Veneer/Bebas and Geist Mono; add no font request.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Raise category text one step while retaining the current mono treatment.
project_context: {"category":"Typography","pattern_name":"Readable uppercase floor","description":"Use 12–13px minimum for tracked uppercase category labels rather than the current 11px.","user_or_business_purpose":"Improves scanning on dark backgrounds without abandoning the label's utility typography.","observed_examples":"LNWY and The Cloister show sparse systems where small labels have room to breathe.","source_urls":"https://www.awwwards.com/sites/lnwy; https://www.awwwards.com/sites/the-cloister","award_or_recognition":"LNWY: Awwwards HM 2017; The Cloister: Awwwards HM 2023","suitable_context":"Short four-item category labels.","unsuitable_context":"Dense legal, metadata, or multilingual labels that require mixed case.","accessibility_considerations":"Test at zoom and on narrow screens; uppercase and tracking can reduce word-shape recognition.","performance_considerations":"CSS only.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Tune tracking from 0.18em toward roughly 0.12–0.16em after visual testing.
project_context: {"category":"Typography","pattern_name":"Tracking scaled with text size","description":"Reduce letter spacing as labels grow so BlackBox Releases stays compact and readable.","user_or_business_purpose":"Maintains the industrial mono voice without creating awkward line length.","observed_examples":"i-D and RCA demonstrate controlled type contrast rather than uniform extreme tracking.","source_urls":"https://winners.webbyawards.com/2025/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/magazine-or-publication/321852/id; https://www.commarts.com/webpicks/rca-records","award_or_recognition":"i-D: Webby winner 2025; RCA: Communication Arts Webpick","suitable_context":"Uppercase labels between 12px and 14px.","unsuitable_context":"Decorative poster headlines where exaggerated tracking is the composition.","accessibility_considerations":"Avoid spacing that makes words hard to parse for low-vision and cognitive users.","performance_considerations":"CSS variable or utility change only.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"medium"}

recommended_application: Do not introduce a third typeface, icon font, or decorative lettering style.
project_context: {"category":"Typography","pattern_name":"Two-level type hierarchy","description":"Limit the header to one display level and one utility level.","user_or_business_purpose":"Keeps the component authored but calm and prevents an award-site aesthetic from becoming a type sampler.","observed_examples":"Analogue Foundation and LNWY rely on restraint; The Music Project shows the risk of turning texture and novelty into the main interface.","source_urls":"https://winners.webbyawards.com/2024/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/music/276789/analogue-foundation; https://www.awwwards.com/sites/lnwy; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/the-music-project/48363/","award_or_recognition":"Analogue Foundation: Webby nominee 2024; LNWY: Awwwards HM 2017; The Music Project: CSSDA Special Kudos 2025","suitable_context":"Small headers with four choices.","unsuitable_context":"Long editorial feature pages needing a broader scale.","accessibility_considerations":"Ensure labels do not depend on stylized glyphs for meaning.","performance_considerations":"Reuses existing font files and reduces style complexity.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Use --store-accent and --store-accent-surface only on active or focused Store elements.
project_context: {"category":"Colour systems and contrast","pattern_name":"Single screen-print accent","description":"Use one existing burgundy accent as a small active-state hit against the monochrome base.","user_or_business_purpose":"Adds Store-specific identity without weakening the label's dark visual continuity.","observed_examples":"UPPERGROUND uses a concentrated label palette; underground poster systems often gain force from one registration colour rather than many.","source_urls":"https://www.awwwards.com/sites/upperground; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/make-it-rain-records/32969/","award_or_recognition":"UPPERGROUND: Awwwards HM 2023; Make It Rain Records: CSSDA WOTD 2018","suitable_context":"Active rules, registration marks, and tiny metadata accents.","unsuitable_context":"Large text areas or broad backgrounds where burgundy contrast is insufficient.","accessibility_considerations":"Verify accent contrast and pair it with border/weight changes.","performance_considerations":"Existing CSS tokens; no asset.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Keep the rail neutral until hover, focus, or current state.
project_context: {"category":"Colour systems and contrast","pattern_name":"Monochrome remains dominant","description":"Keep off-black, near-white, muted grey, and border grey as the main system.","user_or_business_purpose":"Preserves BlackBox's established underground tone and lets artwork remain the loudest colour source.","observed_examples":"LNWY is explicitly black and white; Analogue Foundation uses controlled material restraint.","source_urls":"https://www.awwwards.com/sites/lnwy; https://winners.webbyawards.com/2024/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/music/276789/analogue-foundation","award_or_recognition":"LNWY: Awwwards HM 2017; Analogue Foundation: Webby nominee 2024","suitable_context":"Label stores with visually varied cover art.","unsuitable_context":"Brand systems whose identity requires multiple primary colours.","accessibility_considerations":"Muted text must still meet contrast requirements at small sizes.","performance_considerations":"No new colour assets or filters.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Apply the existing 14% Store accent surface to the current cell only.
project_context: {"category":"Colour systems and contrast","pattern_name":"Layered dark surfaces without glow","description":"Differentiate the active cell with a subtle tint, not gradient, glow, glass, or shadow.","user_or_business_purpose":"Creates state depth while retaining a print/editorial rather than club-tech or luxury feel.","observed_examples":"The Cloister and NAMESAKE use controlled commerce surfaces; Subterranean Dreams shows immersive colour that should not transfer to a utility control.","source_urls":"https://www.awwwards.com/sites/the-cloister; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/namesake/43003; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/subterranean-dreams/45034/","award_or_recognition":"The Cloister: Awwwards HM 2023; NAMESAKE: CSSDA WOTD 2023; Subterranean Dreams: CSSDA Special Kudos 2024","suitable_context":"Square category cells on an off-black page.","unsuitable_context":"Interfaces where elevation conveys actual layering or modality.","accessibility_considerations":"Surface tint cannot be the only current-state cue.","performance_considerations":"One rgba background declaration.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Use foreground, muted-foreground, and a tested metadata opacity; remove metadata if contrast becomes marginal.
project_context: {"category":"Colour systems and contrast","pattern_name":"Three-step text contrast","description":"Use foreground for current labels, muted foreground for inactive labels, and a quieter tone for index/count metadata.","user_or_business_purpose":"Clarifies priority without adding more colours.","observed_examples":"i-D and LNWY use typographic contrast inside limited palettes.","source_urls":"https://winners.webbyawards.com/2025/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/magazine-or-publication/321852/id; https://www.awwwards.com/sites/lnwy","award_or_recognition":"i-D: Webby winner 2025; LNWY: Awwwards HM 2017","suitable_context":"Dark headers with compact metadata.","unsuitable_context":"Very small text where the third tone would fail contrast.","accessibility_considerations":"Metadata still needs readable contrast; do not fade below legibility for style.","performance_considerations":"CSS variables already exist.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Keep min-h-11 or increase cell height while centering label content.
project_context: {"category":"Spacing and density","pattern_name":"44px minimum interaction row","description":"Keep every category link at least 44px high even when the visible text is compact.","user_or_business_purpose":"Makes the rail comfortable for touch and imprecise pointing while preserving visual restraint.","observed_examples":"Recognized responsive references such as UPPERGROUND and The Cloister show dedicated mobile handling; W3C documents minimum target sizing.","source_urls":"https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum.html; https://www.awwwards.com/sites/upperground; https://www.awwwards.com/sites/the-cloister","award_or_recognition":"WCAG 2.2 understanding guidance; UPPERGROUND and The Cloister: Awwwards HM","suitable_context":"All desktop and mobile shelf links.","unsuitable_context":"Inline prose links where target height follows line height.","accessibility_considerations":"Preserve or exceed the existing min-h-11 target.","performance_considerations":"No performance impact.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Use roughly 16–20px mobile inset and 20–24px desktop inset.
project_context: {"category":"Spacing and density","pattern_name":"Consistent cell inset","description":"Use one repeatable horizontal and vertical inset across all shelf cells.","user_or_business_purpose":"Creates record-bin rhythm and prevents the long BlackBox Releases label from feeling cramped.","observed_examples":"Musical Zoo and RCA use repeatable grid spacing as part of the composition.","source_urls":"https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/musical-zoo-festival/33176/; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/rca-records/43114/","award_or_recognition":"Musical Zoo: CSSDA WOTD 2018; RCA: CSSDA Special Kudos 2023","suitable_context":"Equal-cell category grids.","unsuitable_context":"Freeform collage layouts where deliberate misalignment is the primary idea.","accessibility_considerations":"Allow text wrapping without clipping at zoom.","performance_considerations":"CSS Grid gap and padding only.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Let the rule-bounded band breathe; do not wrap it in another card.
project_context: {"category":"Spacing and density","pattern_name":"Negative space as curation","description":"Use measured empty space around the rail instead of adding decorative containers.","user_or_business_purpose":"Makes a small catalog feel intentional and curated rather than underfilled.","observed_examples":"Analogue Foundation, LNWY, and The Cloister use restraint and breathing room as part of brand expression.","source_urls":"https://winners.webbyawards.com/2024/websites-and-mobile-sites/general-desktop-mobile-sites/music/276789/analogue-foundation; https://www.awwwards.com/sites/lnwy; https://www.awwwards.com/sites/the-cloister","award_or_recognition":"Analogue Foundation: Webby nominee 2024; LNWY and The Cloister: Awwwards HM","suitable_context":"Small independent catalogs.","unsuitable_context":"Dense operational interfaces or long category lists.","accessibility_considerations":"Whitespace must not separate labels from their controls or hide focus boundaries.","performance_considerations":"No additional resource cost.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Prototype counts, but make their deletion the first simplification if the rail feels busy.

project_context: {"category":"Mobile behaviour","pattern_name":"Two-by-two shelf ledger","description":"Render four category cells in two columns on narrow screens.","user_or_business_purpose":"Keeps every shelf visible within a compact height and gives labels generous target area.","observed_examples":"The Cloister and UPPERGROUND explicitly present mobile variants; Musical Zoo demonstrates grid rhythm.","source_urls":"https://www.awwwards.com/sites/the-cloister; https://www.awwwards.com/sites/upperground; https://www.cssdesignawards.com/sites/musical-zoo-festival/33176/","award_or_recognition":"The Cloister and UPPERGROUND: Awwwards HM; Musical Zoo: CSSDA WOTD","suitable_context":"Exactly four short category destinations.","unsuitable_context":"Frequently changing category counts or very long localized labels.","accessibility_considerations":"Maintain reading order 01–04 and full-cell focus indication.","performance_considerations":"One media query.","implementation_complexity":"low","confidence":"high"}

recommended_application: Permit two lines in the long cell and keep equal minimum height.
